# Y Pod

> Y Pod is a full-service podcast and video studio in Baku, Azerbaijan. The client talks; filming (operator, light, sound), editing and final delivery are done by the Y Pod team.

## Pages

- [Azərbaycan (Azerbaijani)](https://ypodaz.github.io/): services, pricing, contact
- [English](https://ypodaz.github.io/en/): services, pricing, contact
- [Русский (Russian)](https://ypodaz.github.io/ru/): services, pricing, contact

## Services

- Podcast filming in the studio with 1, 2 or 3 cameras (operator, light and sound included)
- Podcast editing: cutting, audio cleanup, final export
- Reels package: 1 hour of filming and 5 ready Reels, editing included
- Mobile studio: the team comes with equipment to the client's office, clinic or chosen location
- Corporate hour packages for regular shoots

Current prices are listed on each page in the pricing section (currency: AZN).
